title: 日本学（日本と日本人）Ｂ
subtitle: Japanology (Japan and Japanese)B
courseType: Student and Study Skills Courses ProgramCharacter Building CoursesCharacter Building
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Learn about Japanese history and culture.
(2) Learn and think about Japanese features from a variety of perspectives
(3) Learn about the diversity of world values
(4) Improve their reading, writing, and presentation skills
advice:
This general education course will cover the following :

1.Japanese history and culture
2.International comparative research
3.Japan:past and present
4.Group discussions
5. Presentations

Students are required to participate actively in class.
Students are expected to work together in groups to complete tasks in class.
requiredKnowledge:
Academic writing skills
Basic research, discussion, presentation, and computer skills

activityGoals.body: Be able to summarize lectures and write a report using appropriate terminology
Be able to explain the qualities of Japan and the Japanese
Be able to develop an understanding of the diversity of world values
Be able to understand the importance of deepening awareness of a country's culture and history
Be able to express research results and one's own opinions in a logical manner
